fix_reference.fix_summary: Adds an `if (es <= 0)` guard at the top of PSDataColorContig() (tools/tiff2ps.c): when samplesperpixel <= nc the extra-sample stride is zero or negative, which makes the alpha-matte read `adjust = 255 - cp[nc]` walk ahead of cp and past the row buffer; the function now prints TIFFError('Inconsistent value of es: %d') and returns without touching the scanline.

covers_alert_paths: int breaklen = MAXLINE, es = samplesperpixel - nc; -- computed with no validation at tools/tiff2ps.c:2437; the fixture's malformed IFD (StripByteCounts(4) < real 16-byte scanline, unsorted tags) makes libtiff coerce the row geometry down (scanline buffer 4 bytes, es = spp - nc = -2), so the es <= 0 guard is exactly the condition that fires

adjust = 255 - cp[nc]; -- the alpha-matte read at tools/tiff2ps.c:2470, nc bytes AHEAD of cp; cp[nc] lands one byte past the end of the tf_bytesperrow-sized heap buffer tf_buf (address 0 bytes to the right of the 4-byte tf_buf allocation)
povs.description: tiff2ps against the original asarubbo reproducer 00107: a 4-pixel-wide, 1-row RGB TIFF with ExtraSamples=1 (alpha) whose malformed IFD (StripByteCounts(4) < 16, unsorted tags, bogus YResolution/Software offsets) libtiff coerces instead of rejecting, so PSDataColorContig runs with a 4-byte scanline buffer tf_buf and es = samplesperpixel - nc = -2 (never validated at tools/tiff2ps.c:2437). The per-pixel alpha-matte read `adjust = 255 - cp[nc]` (line 2470) then reads one byte past tf_buf -- witnessed AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 at tools/tiff2ps.c:2470 (address 0x...1b4, 0 bytes to the right of the 4-byte region).
povs.exploit_path: tiff2ps <rgb+alpha.tif> -> PSpage RGB-branch (tools/tiff2ps.c:2347, nc=3) -> PSDataColorContig (tools/tiff2ps.c:2434) -> es = samplesperpixel - nc = -2 (line 2437, unvalidated) -> for cc < tf_bytesperrow (4): adjust = 255 - cp[nc] (line 2470) -> cp[nc] = tf_buf+4 = one byte past the 4-byte heap row buffer tf_buf

sink: tools/tiff2ps.c:PSDataColorContig -- `es = samplesperpixel - nc` (line 2437) unvalidated, then `adjust = 255 - cp[nc]` (line 2470) reads nc bytes ahead of cp; with es <= 0 the row walk never advances past where cp[nc] overruns the tf_bytesperrow-sized heap buffer
summary: tiff2ps's PSDataColorContig() computes the 'extra samples' stride `es = samplesperpixel - nc` with no validation. The asarubbo reproducer 00107 (byte-identical fixture here) is an RGB+alpha TIFF whose malformed IFD (StripByteCounts(4) < 16, unsorted tags) libtiff coerces into a 4-byte scanline buffer with es = -2; the alpha-matte adjustment `adjust = 255 - cp[nc]` (tiff2ps.c:2470) then reads one byte PAST the end of the heap buffer -- witnessed heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 (CWE-125), bugzilla 2633. The fix (5ed9fea523316c2f5cec4d393e4d5d671c2dbc33) rejects es <= 0 up front.
trust_boundary: the TIFF's ImageWidth, SamplesPerPixel and ExtraSamples (alpha) IFD tags, driving the tiff2ps CLI's contig-color PostScript emission path
